private_material.title: Kestrel Q3 yield review - Hanlin Fab 2
private_material.text: Internal report, do not distribute. Customer: Hanlin Semiconductor. On wafer line 3 the yield dropped from 92.4% to 88.1% after we switched the laser-scribe recipe to LS-7. Micro-cracks start at the scribe edge and propagate during the 260 C reflow step. We suspect the new dicing tape from Vendor Orin releases too early. Next step: run the KX-12 inspection model on batch 0457 before the customer audit on 14 December.

private_material.title: Aster Bank complaint triage - confidential
private_material.text: We fine-tuned a 7B model on 1.2 million customer complaints from Aster Bank's call centre (2021-2024). Complaints that mention the FlexSaver account are routed to the wrong team 37% of the time, mostly because agents label them as card disputes. The fix under test adds a retrieval step over the bank's internal product manual PM-2023-rev4.

private_material.title: Orchid NPU tape-out status
private_material.text: Orchid NPU tape-out status: the 4 nm design misses timing at 1.8 GHz on the softmax unit. We plan a lookup-table approximation with 256 entries and 12-bit outputs, which cut the critical path by 22% in simulation. Tape-out moves to week 46 if the foundry slot at TSMC Fab 18 holds.
